description: One Rest deployment that has sent funding to this ERPNext site. Created automatically the first time an instance confirms a funding event, so the identifier on every funding record resolves to something a person can recognise.

fields.description: The deployment's own identifier, minted and stored by the Rest app. It namespaces every funding event (`erpnext:<instance_id>:<purchase id>`) and is the document name, so it is unique by construction. Never edited: changing it would re-key every subsequent confirmation and mint duplicate funding records for payments already recorded.
fields.label: Instance ID

fields.description: How this deployment reads in a funding list. Filled from the organization's name when the instance first confirms, so it means something straight away; rename it freely, because it is a label and nothing keys on it.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: The ERPNext site that answered the confirmation. Recorded so a funding record can always be traced to the site it landed on.
fields.label: ERPNext Site

fields.description: An operator's switch. Turning it off records the decision that this deployment should not be confirming funding; it does NOT invalidate or delete anything already recorded.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: How many funding events this instance has confirmed. Maintained by the confirmation method, and useful as a rough cross-check against the app's own ledger.
fields.label: Confirmed Count

name: Rest Instance
